nodes.label: 在多语言结构化工具调用中，同一严格参数失配何时反映真实行动能力损失，何时反映已正确选择行动后的语言条件化可执行值约定失配，何时只是评测或接口契约未显式记录？

data.decision_owner: agent platform implementer or multilingual benchmark evaluator
worlds: W1：用户语言改变语义 grounding 或工具/参数选择；即使执行值约定明确，局部错误归因不会显著改变。
W2：意图和工具选择保持正确，但用户语言中的参数实现违反了固定可执行约定；明确 contract 与 action oracle 会分离该错误类。
W3：严格分数差异主要来自项级 gold、翻译或 validator policy 未被记录；在独立可执行 oracle 下不保留相同归因。
data.discriminator: 一个 revision-pinned item 同时公开工具 schema、gold value、每参数可执行值约定与 validator policy，并与独立 action oracle 和盲审 policy 判断对照。
data.falsifier: 在冻结项目、明确每个参数的可执行约定、使用独立 action oracle 和盲审 policy 判断后，严格失配不能比单一行动能力解释提供更好的可复核区分；此时应 park 或转为 benchmark documentation，而非再造评分器。
data.scope: 仅限已有来源描述的多语言结构化工具调用、严格结构评分与接口执行约定；不是部署伤害或所有 agent 的普遍结论。
data.does_not_establish: 这不是已通过 problem/claim gate 的 proposal，不量化任一解释的频率，也不预设 contract-aware 判断必然优于严格评分。

data.definition: An LLM agent invokes external tools through structured function calls; evaluation must distinguish the action decision from the representation used to execute it.

data.definition: A model produces a structured call that selects a function and supplies arguments under an interface schema or execution convention.
data.does_not_establish: Schema conformance alone does not prove that the requested real-world action is semantically correct.

data.definition: The upstream decision to understand the request and select an appropriate tool before argument realization.
data.does_not_establish: A correct selection does not establish a valid executable call.

data.definition: The language, format, identifier, or normalized representation that a backend expects for each argument value.
data.does_not_establish: A convention is not inherently English-only, and this map does not establish which convention any uninspected API requires.

data.definition: A user-language parameter value can be semantically appropriate while violating a language-invariant execution convention.
data.does_not_establish: The observed MLCL failure mode does not quantify prevalence across all languages, tools, or platforms.

nodes.label: A tool call may have the right intent and selected tool while violating an execution convention in an argument value; separately, protocol implementers have needed to converge schema-validation behavior across clients and servers.

data.incumbent_practice: Treat structured-tool validation and a strict multilingual score as an adequate proxy for correct action.
data.material_consequence: Without a declared value and validator contract, an evaluator or platform owner cannot tell whether a strict failure should be repaired as semantic action, interface realization, or validation interoperability.
data.candidate_construct: an explicit, inspectable action contract that separates semantic intent, executable value convention, and validator interpretation
alternative_explanations: The observed multilingual error is mainly upstream semantic grounding, so a contract layer adds little explanatory value.
The error is mainly a language-conditioned value/interface mismatch after action selection, and its interpretation depends on an unexposed contract.
data.does_not_establish: Neither signal establishes a benchmark-wide defect, a deployment-harm estimate, or a generally effective contract intervention.
